chapter: Pranks, the Mingus fight and Duke's writing
title: Stink bombs and other band jokes
summary: He set off a stink bomb at the Howard during Mood Indigo; he doesn't remember the water in Braud's tuba or the soap on a violinist's bow.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: I read in one book that said that Toby Hardwick used to like to play jokes, too, and sometimes you and he did it together. Is that right?
Oh, I don't remember that. Maybe we did, but I don't remember.
It said that both you and Toby liked practical jokes.
I think I read also, about one where somebody poured water in Braud's tuba?

Oh, the stink bomb. I don't know if I should say that, because they will know who did it, then. That was at the Howard Theatre -- at the Howard Theatre, I bought one of those stink bombs, I went at intermission, and there was a place around 25th Street that sold all of those kinds of things, so I got me a couple of those, and while we were on the stage, I put one on the floor and mashed it, so naturally, the odor went all over. That's when we were playing "Moon Indigo," and the people started saying, "Oh, what stinks?" Everything smelled, you know, and Barney and Whetsol and Metzel was playing the three things together, you know, in front, and they couldn't stand it. They were laughing, and they couldn't even play.

So after a while, the man came backstage and wanted to know who the devil threw that thing over there and wanted to know if it had been anyone in the band, so of course nobody said anything about it. But he really was hot about that.
And it said that members of the

band -- and Barney was one of them -- filled Braud's tuba up with water, and then when he switched from bass to tuba, and blew the tuba, Barney was the one who got wet because the water came out and hit Barney. Were you there, then?
No, I don't guess I was.
You missed one. And then it says that one time, soap was rubbed on the bow of one uppity guest violinist so that he couldn't play. Were you there when they put soap on the violinist's bow?
It doesn't say who. A guest violinist.
Oh no, I don't know anything about that.
